description: Create a PDF from Markdown. Supports headings, paragraphs, bullet/numbered lists, code blocks, quotes, horizontal rules and tables. Inline decoration markers are stripped and the text rendered plain (single font). Nested lists keep their nesting, and wrapped list text lines up after the bullet or number. With tagged: true each item is LI > Lbl (bullet/number) + LBody and each L states ListNumbering (Decimal or Disc) (v0.25.0). A nested list sits inside its parent LBody under PDF/UA-1, and directly in the parent L right after the item under PDF/UA-2 (pdfVersion "2.0"; ISO 32000-2 §14.8.4.8.2) (v0.27.0).

drawTitle.description: Whether to draw title as a heading at the top of the body. Default true. Pass false when the body already starts with its own heading (e.g. a Markdown "# ..." line): the title then goes into the metadata only (Info /Title, and XMP dc:title when tagged), so tagged output keeps the dc:title PDF/UA requires (ISO 14289-1 7.1 / ISO 14289-2 8.11.1) without a duplicated heading.

fontPath.description: Absolute path of the font file to embed (.ttf / .otf). Required for characters outside WinAnsiEncoding (Japanese, for example). .ttc (TrueType Collection) is not supported. Can also be set via the PDF_WRITER_FONT environment variable.

lang.description: Natural language of the document (BCP 47, e.g. "ja" / "en-US"). When omitted with tagged, it is inferred from the text and the guess is reported in warnings. A wrong language declaration makes screen readers misread — state it explicitly when you know it.

margin.description: Margin on all sides (pt). Default 56 (about 20 mm). Range 0-300.

onMissingGlyph.description: What to do with characters the font lacks (e.g. ✔ U+2714, missing from Noto Sans JP). error (default) = fail, listing the missing characters / replace = substitute 〓 with a warning (? when the font lacks 〓, so always ? with the standard font) / ignore = render as blanks with a warning.

outputPath.description: Destination file path (absolute). When omitted, a base64 string is returned instead.

pdfVersion.description: PDF version to output. Default "1.7". "2.0" (ISO 32000-2) satisfies not just the version claim but the duties bound to it: a trailer /ID is added (Required per Table 15), and the Info dictionary is trimmed to CreationDate / ModDate with title, author and Producer moved to XMP (§14.3.3). With tagged: true, "2.0" declares PDF/UA-2 instead of PDF/UA-1 (PDF/UA-1 allows only PDF 1.0 to 1.7, ISO 14289-1 §6.1).

returnBase64.description: When true, include a base64 string in the result in addition to saving.

tagged.description: Generate as a tagged PDF (PDF/UA, ISO 14289). Default false. When true, a structure tree, the PDF/UA declaration, /Lang and DisplayDocTitle are added, making the document readable by screen readers. PDF/UA requires a title, so title becomes required. Which part is declared follows pdfVersion: PDF/UA-1 (ISO 14289-1) on the default 1.7, PDF/UA-2 (ISO 14289-2, pdfuaid:part 2 and rev 2024) with pdfVersion "2.0". Under PDF/UA-2 the drawn title is a Title element (not H1), Markdown headings keep their own level, and structure elements are placed in the PDF 2.0 namespace (BlockQuote and Code, which it lacks, stay in the PDF 1.7 one).

title.description: PDF title. Always set in the metadata, and drawn as a heading at the top of the body unless drawTitle is false.

title: Create PDF from Markdown
